UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: User profile containing XP, streak, tasks, classes, and apps for persistence.

uid.description: Unique user ID of the student matching request.auth.uid

email.description: Google email address of the student

tasks.description: Workspace study tasks with AI recommendations

papers.description: User uploaded past papers and worksheet evaluation records

deepseekApiKey.description: User custom DeepSeek API key for personalized AI reasoning

habits.description: User custom study and routine habit items

habitLogs.description: Daily habit completion checkboxes and mood/sleep metrics

habitStartDate.description: Starting anchor date for habit tracking matrix

exams.description: Student exam countdown schedule items with date, time, subject, and notes

friends.description: Study buddies and mutual focus leaderboard connections

friendUsername.description: User personalized public handle for study buddy invitations

inviteCode.description: Unique invite code for friend connection links

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was modified

/users/{userId}.description: Main document that persists all study portal workspace criteria for a single student.
